tips.alwaysAvailableDesc: Content from Main URLs is injected directly into the prompt without semantic search.

scrapingTips.title: Tips for Successful Scraping:
scrapingTips.tip1: Large websites may take some time. Please be patient.
scrapingTips.tip2: If a page fails, you can retry it later from the project dashboard.
scrapingTips.tip3: Make sure your website responds quickly and doesn't aggressively block scrapers.
scrapingTips.tip4: You don't need to select every single page, only those with useful information for your chatbot.
scrapingTips.tip5: You can add more URLs or remove scraped URLs after the initial scraping is done.
scrapingTips.tip6: Ensure that your API key is correctly configured.
